reason: The initial 0.05-degree DEM crop reproduced the frozen outlet grid exactly but the upstream D8 catchment touched the crop boundary. This contract fixes an outcome-blind expansion rule before any larger-domain delineation is executed.
forbidden_inputs: target basin area, perimeter, channel length, relief or slope
base_extent_rule: Compute min/max WGS84 longitude/latitude of frozen MML R4, R8 and R9 anchors.
selection_rule: Use the first margin in the frozen sequence whose D8 upstream mask from the frozen outlet spatial coordinate does not touch any DEM crop boundary.
outlet_mapping_rule: For each expanded grid, map the frozen accepted outlet EPSG:32718 x/y coordinate to the containing 30 m cell and require its cell-center distance to the frozen coordinate to be no greater than one DEM-cell diagonal.
source_integrity_rule: Hash every downloaded Copernicus GLO-30 source tile and fail closed if any source tile shared with the frozen outlet diagnostic differs from its persisted SHA256.
fail_closed_conditions: frozen outlet coordinate cannot be mapped within one cell diagonal
all frozen margins still clip the upstream catchment
